findings.root_cause: Watchdog polled /health during launch_ac() blocking. Health timeout triggered false restart. Fixed: GAME_LAUNCHING sentinel (RAII guard) suppresses watchdog during launch.
findings.fix_description: GAME_LAUNCHING sentinel in ws_handler.rs (RAII guard with 5min TTL). Watchdog reads sentinel at service.rs:293 and skips restart cycle.
findings.escalation_message: GAME_LAUNCHING sentinel fix deployed in build 8510946f. If this symptom recurs, check: (1) sentinel file at C:\RacingPoint\GAME_LAUNCHING exists during launch, (2) watchdog logs show 'skipping restart+rollback', (3) sentinel TTL hasn't expired (5min max).

symptom_patterns: health check fails during game start
findings.root_cause: launch_ac() blocked for 40s+ (polling + stability check). HTTP server on same thread couldn't respond. Fixed: zero-block launch via bat subprocess + event loop PID discovery.
findings.fix_description: launch_ac() now returns in <1s. Bat subprocess handles kill+launch. Event loop discovers PID via find_game_pid(). Post-launch window management done by periodic tick.
findings.escalation_message: Zero-block launch deployed in b688c3ea. Agent should return from launch_ac() in <1s. If blocking recurs, check: launch-ac.bat exists at C:\RacingPoint\, event loop WaitingForLive state transitions.

findings.root_cause: LapCompleted sent only via WS. If WS disconnected, lap data silently dropped. Fixed: CSV fallback saves to laps-offline.csv when send fails.
findings.fix_description: csv_lap_fallback.rs: saves lap to C:\RacingPoint\laps-offline.csv when ws_tx.send() fails. VMS pattern — laps are never lost.
findings.escalation_message: CSV lap fallback deployed in d697bc91. Check C:\RacingPoint\laps-offline.csv for unsync'd laps. TODO: implement sync-back on WS reconnect.

findings.root_cause: If PowerShell WMI watcher fails to start, no error visible. Process guard runs during protected game launch. Fixed: tasklist fallback poller (5s) detects protected games without WMI.
findings.fix_description: safe_mode.rs: spawn_tasklist_fallback() polls tasklist every 5s for protected game exe names. Used when WMI watcher fails.
findings.escalation_message: Tasklist fallback deployed in d697bc91. If safe mode still not activating: check rc-agent logs for 'Tasklist fallback' messages. Verify PROTECTED_EXE_NAMES list matches actual game .exe names.

findings.root_cause: External taskkill or system shutdown killed rc-agent with no log. Fixed: SetConsoleCtrlHandler logs termination reason to termination.log and cleans sentinel files.
findings.fix_description: main.rs: SetConsoleCtrlHandler catches CTRL_C, CTRL_CLOSE, CTRL_LOGOFF, CTRL_SHUTDOWN. Writes to C:\RacingPoint\termination.log with reason code and timestamp.
findings.escalation_message: Check C:\RacingPoint\termination.log for last kill reason. If file absent, the process was killed by TerminateProcess (bypasses ctrl handler). Check Sysmon or Event Viewer.

findings.root_cause: Edge browser blanking uses ~300MB RAM, 2-5s cold start, SNSS session restore, state race (state=Blank before browser verified). VMS uses native MFC dialog (~5MB, instant). This is NOT YET FIXED — it is a known architectural gap.
findings.fix_description: NOT FIXED. Requires replacing Edge with native Win32 fullscreen window (CBlankingDlg equivalent). Workarounds: SNSS cleanup, Preferences patching, predictive_maintenance edge count check.
findings.escalation_message: KNOWN GAP: Edge blanking is unreliable. Check edge_process_count at :18924/debug. If 0 with state=blanked, Edge launch failed. Temporary fix: restart rc-agent. Permanent fix: native Win32 blanking (not yet implemented).

findings.root_cause: rollback_manager.rs renames rc-agent.exe → rc-agent-failed.exe on crash detection. VMS never renames binaries. If rollback triggers during launch timeout, can corrupt running process. NOT YET FIXED.
findings.fix_description: NOT FIXED. Requires disabling binary rename in rollback_manager.rs (VMS pattern: single binary, SCM restart only).
findings.escalation_message: KNOWN GAP: rollback_manager may rename rc-agent.exe during launch. If rc-agent-failed.exe exists alongside rc-agent.exe, a rollback was triggered. Check rollback-state.json for depth count.
